subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, $x$ and $y$, for data set P. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. Data set Q is created by subtracting $9$ units from the value of $y$ for each data point from data set P. Which of the following is closest to the $y$-coordinate of the $y$-intercept of the line of best fit for data set Q?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The line of best fit for data set P can be written as $y = mx + b$, where $b$ is the $y$-coordinate of the $y$-intercept. From the graph, the $y$-intercept of the line of best fit for data set P is approximately $47.50$. Subtracting $9$ from each $y$-value shifts the line vertically downward by $9$ units but does not change the slope. Therefore, the $y$-intercept of the line of best fit for data set Q is $47.50 - 9 = 38.50$.
